about: QD1 redo (2026-11-03, wildshard-v's 11:30 read): Jake's 7 QA spots in Nine, posed to his shots. Position (x, z) by correlating each 1 m grid spot's minimap with his minimap (0.84-0.96); feet height y by the level he stood on; yaw / pitch in degrees (yaw 0 = north = -z, 90 = east = +x) matched by eye. Used by tmp-free reshoots through window.__wildshard.pose({x, z, y, yaw: -yaw rad, pitch: pitch rad}).
